players.product: Susquehanna nuclear + PJM baseload gas generation contracted to data centers (Amazon ~2 GW PPA, powered-land sites)

quarterly_data.signal: In the PJM Base Residual Auction for the 2028/2029 planning year (June 1, 2028 through May 31, 2029), Talen cleared a total of 10,180 megawatts at a clearing price of $325 per megawatt-day across the PJM Interconnection RTO, equating to approximately $1,208 million in capacity revenues for that planning year.
quarterly_data.figure: 10,180 MW cleared at $325 per megawatt-day; approximately $1,208 million capacity revenues (2028/2029)
